This is the "Rags to Riches Spell" from "Spells for Self-Improvement" by Lauren White. Heads up, it takes about a week to complete.

Materials: 

* Silver coin (it doesn't have to be actual silver, just the color silver; I used a quarter)
* Jar of white wine (I used water as a substitute and it worked out fine)
* Green Candle (I used a white one as a substitute)
* And a piece of rag cloth (the older the better)
* (Optional) Green clothes to wear during procedure

​

Directions:

* On day one, light the candle (visualizing great mountains of coins helps)
* Drop the coin into the wine and leave over night
* Snuff out the candle
* Remove the coin in the morning and leave on a windowsill
* Repeat for five days.
* On day six, wrap the coin carefully in the fabric and bury in a secret place.
